chapter: Opening, arrival in Los Angeles and the Quality Four
title: The Embassy band and its members
summary: Mrs. Howard and Howard name the players in the first big band at the Embassy, including Louis Taylor, George Orendorff, Lawrence Brown, Charlie Lawrence and tuba player James Jackson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

No. Is that the trombone player?
Yeah.
He's a trombone player out of Chicago.
No, I didn't -- this group with (inaudible).
He was with (inaudible). And do who is that the Embassy you remember Quince Street that was on --
Embassy?
